messages:
Iris: Quick check 1 1 proposing we regroup the left rail by journey (Build 1 Serve 1 Observe). Mock attached. Main concerns: permalinks, keyboard jumps, breadcrumbs.

Ben: Thumbs up on the mental model. Permalinks must not break. Suggest keep canonical resource paths like `/console/models/:id` and map rail state to `?cluster=`.

Naveen: Agree. Also add lightweight fragment anchors for sections: `#panel=metrics`. Use `history.replaceState` when navigating to anchors so back-button is clean.

Claire: Accessibility: add `aria-current="true"` to the active rail item and `aria-expanded` on group toggles. When cluster changes announce "Switched to Serve" via a polite live region.

A11yBot: /scan rail -> Found missing `aria-expanded` on 2 toggles and no live region. Recommend `role=region` + `aria-live=polite` for the cluster content.

Iris: Breadcrumb copy: prefer "Console 7 Models 7 ImageGen v1.2" but clamp at 42 chars and show full name in tooltip/long-press. Mobile shows compact form "ImageGen v1.2".

Ben: For analytics, normalize query params server-side and emit a synthetic path like `/console/models/:id/cluster/serve` for reporting. Also preserve utm params through redirects.

Naveen: Action items: 1) routing adapter + redirect plan (Ben), 2) aria + live region + tests (Claire), 3) breadcrumb copy + truncation doc (Iris). Sync Thu 9:30.

Claire: I'll run axe and paste results. Will add a tiny keyboard e2e for focus order.

Ben: I'll prototype the mapping layer and include redirect examples. ETA Tue.

Iris: Thanks folks 1 mock and short Loom: https://loom.com/share/zzz111 (1:30).
